prompt:
Our enterprise skills marketplace is failing a Q1 compliance audit. We have a directory of skills at `/workspace/enterprise-skills` that has never been through an automated security review. The compliance officer needs three things done before end of day:

1. Run a full supply-chain security scan on the entire skills directory and make sure the scan evidence is saved somewhere on disk.

2. For the most dangerous skill found, generate and save a plain-English explanation of exactly why it was flagged — save this to `/workspace/security-evidence/shell-executor-explanation.txt`.

3. Quarantine that most dangerous skill so it cannot be used in production.

Please use the tooling described in the `SKILL.md` file at the workspace root to accomplish this. The scan must use the officially supported pinned version of the tool.
